This analog pedal features a JFET design and offers versatile sound shaping with Level, Tone, and Drive controls, plus an Open/Closed toggle for tonal variations. It's a portable powerhouse designed for tour-grade performance. What Keeley Electronics say about the SUPER BASS Overdrive and Distortion Available exclusively at Sweetwater.com ONLY $99! Click here to buy now! Heritage Sonics Meet Portable Pedal Power Since its original late-1960s release, one super-stellar amp has transcended generations of hard-hitting sound, finding homes among the legendary likes of Eric Johnson, Angus Young, Jimi Hendrix, Edward Van Halen, Uli John Roth, and Billie Joe Armstrong, to name a few. Now, in an ode to time-tested tones, Keeley pays homage to this pantheon of power with its Super Bass overdrive and distortion pedal — and you can only get it at Sweetwater! Driven by an iconic JFET design, this supercharged amp-in-a-box pulls no punches in channeling the hallmark haymaker that inspired it, with the analog Super Bass transmuting its tone-crafting tenacity into a portable powerhouse. Its straightforward design is teeming with satisfying tactility, utilizing robust control knobs for its Level, Tone, and Drive parameters. Meanwhile, a dedicated 2-way toggle for Open and Closed operation let you instantly traverse two distinct worlds of sonic contouring. Available exclusively at Sweetwater.com Click here to buy now! Keeley Super Bass Overdrive and Distortion Features: Iconic overdrive and distortion from one of the rock world’s most-lauded amps is distilled into a pedalboard-friendly powerhouse — available only at Sweetwater Robust controls ensure satisfying tactility and detailed tone-crafting possibilities Rugged housing delivers long-haul, tour-grade performance Open/closed 2-way toggle provides immediate access to multitudes of sonic potential Proudly made in the US along with the rest of Keeley’s boutique-grade stompbox creations Pedal Type: Overdrive, Distortion Analog/Digital: Analog Inputs: 1 x 1/4″ Outputs: 1 x 1/4″ EQ: Tone Control Controls: Drive, Level, Open/Closed switch Power Source: 9V DC power supply (sold separately) The SUPER BASS Overdrive and Distortion is part of our new and affordable array of Keeley Pedals, Engineered, Designed, and Manufactured in the USA, and only available at Sweetwater!
